title: Automatic ad and segment skipping
message: Faster automatic activation of supported Skip Ad and segment controls, configurable skip categories, and lower-overhead mutation handling.
features: Automatic click of visible and enabled Skip Ad controls, including countdown-to-enabled transitions
Twelve configurable segment categories with supported page metadata mapping
Master automatic-skip toggle and allowlist-aware behavior
Mutation coalescing and throttled scans to reduce page performance overhead
No media/DRM manipulation; ads without a supported skip control cannot be skipped
